name: Blizzara
doc: Blizzara (the spell): the director - every 20 ticks the ice block of the next action on its first target: four ice pillars, the burst, the block growing out of the ground with falling chunks and mist, then breaking from the top into spinning shards, the sound; the damage. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag103_blizzara.cpp) run on the program's memory (its pools and model copies in the magic buffer).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Ice block
parts.doc: One ice block an action on its first target: the ice pillars, the burst, the block growing out of the ground with falling chunks and mist, then breaking into shards, the sound; the damage

params.label: Damage tick
params.doc: The damage at this tick of the ice block

params.label: Ice
params.doc: The sprite sequence ice (a flipbook of 16 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

params.label: Block model
params.doc: The prim model block (a mesh of 134 vertices, 223 primitives: an edited one keeps its vertices (its code reads them by number))

params.label: Pillar model
params.doc: The prim model pillar (a mesh of 120 vertices, 96 primitives: an edited one keeps its vertices (its code reads them by number))

params.label: Burst model
params.doc: The prim model burst (a mesh of 54 vertices, 36 primitives: an edited one keeps its vertices (its code reads them by number))
